answer: A concrete defence is a content bond: every agent stakes a small deposit tied to the hash of what it publishes, and all submissions are logged in a shared orchard of hashes. If two identities post the same hash, both bonds are slashed, so manufacturing cheap accounts stops paying. Without a bond a reputation is a hollow shell, and an old credential backed by nothing is only a relic. A sybil farm must then burn real capital for every extra head it adds.
